chunks: And surely it is an oath; if you could know, [it is] great.
ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of the oath mentioned in Surah Al-Waqi'ah verse 75-76?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted as Allah swearing by His own essence or a specific attribute, emphasizing the certainty of the Resurrection and the reality of the Hereafter. The phrase 'if you knew' highlights the gap between superficial awareness and deep spiritual insight, urging believers to internalize the gravity of divine promises. This oath serves as a rhetorical device to awaken the heedless from their complacency regarding the inevitability of death and judgment.
